Name: Stardew Valley 1.6 Paint Masks
Author: Lavliette
Description:
Hiho!

These paint masks currently only include all the seasonal tilesheets from Maps - Terrain Features and Cursors aren't included. 
The Fall Tilesheet also has a Mask for the trees, however that part is missing from the other tilesheet (they were created with Simple Foliage in mind) - I'd recommend only recolouring dirt, grass and cliffs and leaving trees and buildings as is, since there are great replacements for them. ♥

These paint masks are free to use and edit as long as you link back to this mod here. 
Also check out my paint mask for Daisyniko's Tilesheets: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14089
